title: Random example sample budget
statement: For each $n\in\mathbb{N}$, positive rational influence bound $t$, and rational accuracy parameter $\varepsilon$ with $0<\varepsilon\le 1/2$, define the sample budget to be $n$ times the singleton-influence sample count, plus the learning-consequences family bound times the bounded-family sample count evaluated at that family bound and its positivity proof.
caveat: The referenced sample-count and family-bound definitions are not included, so their exact mathematical meanings cannot be made self-contained.
